## Step 9 - coe.3 outside the brooding period, 2014 v 2017

2017 coe.3 (n = 3) against 2014 coe.3 sampled before brooding. Welch's t-tests on log2 values; null hypothesis: equal means. Damage as lesions per 10 kb (2017 minus 2014); other measures as fold (2017 / 2014); 95% CI in brackets. Year is confounded with month, exact location and sample storage time.

| A (9) | Short COI per DNA input | 1.27 (1.04 to 1.55) | 0.030 |
